question: What is included in the service desk?
html:
The service desk centres on HELIX, which the growth plan turns into a product-led service desk with a Tier-0 AI agent. A cyber-posture subscription and legal-AI enablement follow as add-ons (Frontline growth plan). The context does not include a full service catalogue, so coverage hours, service levels and supported applications cannot be confirmed here.

What the desk includes

ComponentStatusSource
HELIX service deskBeing made product-led in Phase 1 (months 0-12)Frontline growth plan
Tier-0 AI agentPhase 1 addition to HELIXFrontline growth plan
Cyber-posture subscriptionPhase 1 add-onFrontline growth plan
Legal-AI enablementPhase 1 add-on for the AM Law baseFrontline growth plan
Offshore deliveryGoa, Hyderabad, Cape TownFrontline public filings

Why legal-AI enablement is included

  • ILTA finds 68% of firms have Copilot, but only 8% have deployed it firm-wide (Frontline growth plan).
  • The desk is positioned to help firms close that gap.

Who it serves

  • Frontline works with 900+ law-firm clients (June 2026 press, cited in the Frontline growth plan).
  • About half the AM Law 200 are clients (Frontline growth plan).
  • Phase 2 (months 6-18) extends the offer to mid-size firms. The 16-metro screen covers 143 firms and 17,042 attorneys. Top-ranked firms carry a "bundle" recommendation (Mid-size law firms).

What is not yet confirmed

The context does not cover these points:

  • Support tiers beyond Tier-0 and what each one handles.
  • Coverage hours and response or resolution targets.
  • Supported practice-management, document and billing applications.
  • Pricing, and how the add-ons attach to the core desk.

The HELIX service catalogue, client service-level schedules and ticket data by tier would answer these.

The month-12 plan assumes margin rises to about 16.7% (est.), partly from Tier-0 deflection and cyber attach, so the scope of this desk is where much of the early EBITDA growth has to come from (Frontline growth plan). All Frontline revenue and EBITDA figures are analyst estimates, not company disclosures (Frontline public filings).

Next actions

  1. Pull the current HELIX service catalogue and service-level schedules to publish a confirmed scope.
  2. Baseline ticket volume by tier, so Tier-0 deflection can be measured against the month-12 margin assumption.
  3. Define the bundle for the 37 mid-size firms scoring 65+ before Phase 2 outreach.
  4. Set attach-rate targets for the cyber-posture and legal-AI add-ons across the AM Law base.
